title: COMPACT AND HIGH PERFORMANCE SOLAR ARRAY EXPRO PLUS
description: Objective: To develop a compact and high-performance solar array with an increase in the power per stowed volume ratio, with an overarching goal to increase number of satellites per launch.Description: A compact solar array concept is essential for the mega-constellation market, which requires systems compatible with a multi-satellite launch scheme. For this reason, the solar array itself has to occupy a minimum volume when stowed, while maintaining a high performance figure. The main target is thus to find solutions toincrease the W/m3 figure of merit. This high compactness can be achieved by using flexible solar array technologies and/or fully flexible PVA (photovoltaic assembly) but these are not the only solutions. Therefore, to achieve the goal of this activity, any technology that can lead to an increase in the highest W/m3 is of interest. This activity encompasses the following tasks: - Identification of solar array concepts allowing for reaching power per volume figures of > 30 kW/m3 and respective building blocks- Mechanical analysis of identified solutions - Development and breadboarding of technology building blocks required to meet the identified solutions in the previous task - Engineering tests

title: European Monitoring of Biodiversity in Agricultural Landscapes (EMBAL) 2028
description:
OBJECTIVES:
The general objectives of this contract are to contribute towards i) the establishment of a robust data series on the state of biodiversity in agricultural landscapes in the EU, and ii) a better understanding of (the impacts of policy actions on) the biodiversity trends in agricultural landscapes at the EU and national level. 
The specific objectives of this contract are i) to undertake the EMBAL field survey in all EU Member States in 2028 and 2029, and ii) to analyse the collected data. The contract will survey at least 4500 sites in each year (i.e. undertake at least 9 000 site-surveys across the two years), strictly following the EMBAL survey protocol and technical guidelines as prepared and executed in the EMBAL survey 2022/2023. 

TASKS:
1) Preparation of the field survey (including sampling strategy and design, pre-processing of monitoring sites, selection and recruitment of surveyors, material and equipment, digitised data workflow, helpdesk, quality control and contingency planning);
2) Execution of the field survey;
3) Data post-processing;
4) Data analysis;
5) Organisation of a conference to present the results.

Institutions and companies are therefore invited to submit Outline Proposals for the development of activities of national relevance and matching institutional interests.
